verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence mentions a QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero integration, or any GL account, class, or department mapping. The generic transaction retrieval/update API and custom-field management (navan-docs-2, navan-docs-4, navan-docs-23) are building blocks a finance team could use for its own integration, but they do not show a native accounting sync with controllable mappings.
